preflight_gate_scan.reading: the in-flight limit can end the boost only before the apex; after the apex it flags. The pre-flight gate is the control that keeps the truth web above 1 mm on the total-flux law. Rows give the trade between the kept fraction of the (a, n) band and the truth web margin; the threshold is a proposal for the lead until T1-T4 measure a, n and their scatter.
